title: EGSE: Evidence-Grounded Skill Evolution for Medical Reasoning Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.33909v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Medical reasoning agents combine foundation models with specialized tools to interpret medical images, yet reusing their historical experience remains challenging. A correct final answer can conceal flawed reasoning or tool use, synthesized advice may lack source support, and superficially similar cases may require different diagnostic procedures. In this paper, we propose EGSE, an evidence-grounded skill evolution framework that distills historical dialogues from similar cases into reusable conditional workflows and progressively refines a multi-faceted skill library through supported and validated updates to improve medical agents. EGSE evaluates intermediate reasoning and tool use and contrasts repeated successful and failed rollouts to extract useful practices and evidence-supported avoidance guidance. translated_title: EGSE：面向医学推理智能体的基于证据技能演化框架
translated_abstract: 医学推理智能体将基础模型与专用工具相结合以解读医学图像，然而如何复用其历史经验仍然具有挑战性。正确的最终答案可能掩盖有缺陷的推理或工具使用过程，合成得到的建议可能缺乏来源支持，而表面上相似的病例可能需要不同的诊断流程。在本文中，我们提出了EGSE，一个基于证据的技能演化框架，它将相似病例的历史对话提炼为可复用的条件化工作流程，并通过有支撑且经过验证的更新逐步完善多方面的技能库，从而改进医学智能体。EGSE评估中间推理与工具使用过程，并对比重复出现的成功与失败执行结果，以提取有用的实践经验以及有证据支持的规避指导。这些经验被合成为带有适用性条件的工作流程，且其检查可追溯至源对话。（注：原摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: EGSE框架通过将相似病例的历史对话提炼为可复用、可溯源的条件化工作流程，并基于对成功与失败轨迹的证据化对比分析持续完善技能库，从而提升医学推理智能体的可靠性与性能。
en_tdlr: EGSE is an evidence-grounded skill evolution framework that distills historical dialogues from similar cases into reusable conditional workflows and progressively refines a validated skill library to improve medical reasoning agents.
